title: Anyone else have space as a location?
content: Once In awhile I have dreams where theres a place outside of earth, just outside the ozone layer. In about half of my mallworld/backroom dreams I can fly. This dream had familiar places from my mallworld, Ive been to this space location before but I dont visit it often. Its just a place with stuff from memories, stuff I want to remember. Things from my childhood I ddint want to throw away, stuff like that. Its hard to breathe up there and I have to hold my breath. Thats why I dont go up there alot. Idk if anyone else has something like this. Its a place for old memories I dont want to loose but dont want in my dayily life.
